name: Brembo
description: Brembo was a terrestrial planet whose surface consisted of volcanic rock. It was located in the Thanium sector's Felucia system, found in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Brembo occupied the second orbital position around the star Felix and had no moons.
